newsitem.title: JAPAN: Indonesia allocates 3.7 mln barrels of Feb LSWR.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia allocates 3.7 mln barrels of Feb LSWR.

text.p: Indonesia's state oil company, Pertamina, has allocated a total of 3.7 million barrels of low sulphur waxy residue (LSWR) for loading in February, up from January's 3.5 million barrels, traders said on Monday.
They said the allocation was larger in volume because unsold January cargoes had been carried over to February.
January sales were hindered by high prices, they said.

Pacific Petroleum has been allocated 260,000 barrels, Far East Investment 540,000 barrels, Itochu Corp 180,000 barrels, Kipco 210,000 barrels, Perta 560,000 barrels, Permindo 850,000 barrels and British Petroleum Co Plc (BP) 1.1 million barrels, traders said.
Details on the loading schedule were not yet unavailable, they said.
Traders said Japanese demand for February LSWR, used by utilities for direct burning, was glum as many domestic refiners are producing their own supplies, rather than relying on imported cargoes.
